body:
My experience started at 16, I'm now 23. I was already into smoking pot and taking any opiate I could get, although it was usually darvocet.
One fine day I noticed another bottle marked 'alprazolam,' or, as you probably know, xanax. I had heard of xanax, and I looked at the little bottle a bit closer, and low and behold, there was the little geq, or generic equivalent, to xanax, so I took four and popped one right away, not being experienced with it yet. I soon got that beautiful sense of well being,and that wonderful floaty feeling.
I then realized that most of these drugs, generically speaking, ended in -am or -pam. Now things got really interesting. I noticed that they would, if not stop my opiate withdrawals, at least they would make it so I could sleep and tolerate the w/d's alot easier. I soon noticed that for me, if I didn't have my dearly beloved opiates, I could seem like regular old me, as far as being able to carry on conversation, and all the normal social expectancies at parties and such, you know, those groovy gatherings among close friends, sittin around the pipes, sharin and not carin.
